Molde Fotballklubb is a football club based in Molde, Norway, that competes in Eliteserien, the top flight of Norwegian football. Founded on 19 June 1911, the club was originally known as International and changed its name to Molde in 1915. Molde is five-time league champions and six-time Norwegian Cup winner, and has finished second in the league a further eleven times. Molde is one of only four Norwegian clubs to have participated in the UEFA Champions League.
